why: The general problem (minimal forbidden induced subgraphs for all word-representable graphs) remains open, but several post-snapshot papers give complete forbidden-induced-subgraph characterizations for specific restricted cases: split graphs (arXiv 2512.12259, 2507.08483), co-bipartite graphs (arXiv 2512.12274), Km-Kn graphs (arXiv 2508.15177), and near-triangulations (arXiv 2605.25733). These settle restrictions of the stated problem for specific graph families, which is a case of the problem being narrowed even though the full characterization is still open.
queries: "word-representable graphs" Wikipedia forbidden subgraphs open problem
